newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - BCN STILL AN ING BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BCN STILL AN ING BUY.

text.p: ING Barings said it had reiterated its buy rating on Brazilian private bank BCN.
- The report followed BCN's purchase of Minas Gerais state bank Credireal for the base price of 121.3 million reais at a privatization auction on Thursday.

- ING Barings saw the acquisition as positive as it strengthens the bank's presence in the southeastern state of Minas Gerais. It also said it considered the price paid by BCN attractive on a price-to-assets and price-to-branch basis.
- BCN preferred was up 1.94 percent at 15.80 reais in late afternoon trade on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
